description: Changes the developer's profile and replaces the previous values: `name` and `lang`, and the studio page (play.neblla.com/studio/<studioSlug>, the business web on their Stripe account, and the «by <name>» link in the gallery). Changing the name also updates the owner name on all their apps. `studioSlug` is the short name (3-30, lower case letters, digits, hyphens), optional `about` (who they are, since when; up to 1500 characters), `web` (their official site) and `links` ([{ label?, url }], up to 6). Send `about`, `web` or `links` as null or [] to clear them. Returns the profile as neblla_developer_profile does.

name.description: New public name: what users see as the author of the developer's apps (e.g. a studio or company name). The email is never shown.

studioSlug.description: The studio's short name: its page play.neblla.com/studio/<studioSlug>

name: neblla_developer_profile_update
title: Developer profile update
